name: Parmax Pharma Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1994, Parmax Pharma Ltd manufactures Bulk Drugs, Drug Intermediates & Speciality Chemicals.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
PPL is engaged in the manufacture and supply 
of bulk drugs (APIs) and selected formulations 
catering primarily to the Indian pharma industry.

pros: Debtor days have improved from 30.5 to 16.6 days.
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
